address: National Gallery Singapore, #02-01, (Coleman Street entrance), 1 St. Andrew's Road, 178957, Singapore
bio: Art and sculptures aren’t the only treasures found in the National Gallery – on the 2nd floor is this restaurant from Violet Oon, Singapore’s own national treasure and one of its greatest ambassadors. The handsome, panelled 1920s-style dining room is an ideal backdrop to the cooking which, through its spicing, contrasting textures and enticing aromas, showcases Singapore’s unique culinary heritage. This is a restaurant with genuine charm....
